name: 21244 · Windsor Mill, MD
findings: ZIP 21244 (Windsor Mill) has 178 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21244 (Windsor Mill) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21244 (Windsor Mill) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
